name: Platformer Test
author: Bruno Garcia
description: A simple platformer test: run and jump across the blocks with a little bunny-like hero. A tech demo from WASM-4's early days.

descriptions.en: A simple platformer test: run and jump across the blocks with a little bunny-like hero. A tech demo from WASM-4's early days.
descriptions.it: Un semplice test di platform: corri e salta tra i blocchi con un piccolo eroe simile a un coniglio. Una demo tecnica dei primi giorni di WASM-4.
